objective: Certify Field Visit ERP observation and latest-unique-business ERP Intelligence while preserving zero-loss offline recovery and all canonical authority boundaries.

humanGate.reason: Only the Owner may manually apply Migration 048 after exact-head controller certification.

budgets.dataAuthority: public.field_visits(erp_usage_state, erp_id) owns only the ERP observed during that visit; public.erp_systems remains the canonical ERP dictionary; distributor_accounts.erp_id and financial authorities must not be mutated.
budgets.readBudget: ERP options are one bounded server read; visit lists join canonical ERP names without per-row requests; ERP Intelligence is one server-authoritative latest-business aggregate independent of page length.
budgets.writeBudget: One service-role confirmation boundary may atomically resolve/create one canonical ERP and confirm one same-ID Field Visit. No cross-authority or historical-backfill writes are allowed.
budgets.rlsModel: Browser clients cannot mutate erp_systems or execute the ERP confirmation RPC; active segment capability is revalidated server-side and the database boundary is service-role only.
budgets.indexRequirements: Only the measured latest-business field_visits index introduced by Migration 048 is allowed; no speculative indexes.
budgets.failureMode: ERP contract validation or capability/schema failure leaves the same visit safely local with its ERP observation intact; legacy queued visits remain compatible.
budgets.concurrencyModel: Exact visit_id idempotency, canonical normalized ERP keys, and one PostgreSQL transaction prevent duplicate visits, ERP rows, and orphan dimensions.
budgets.idempotencyModel: Retries preserve visit_id; normalized ERP variants resolve to one canonical ERP; a failed confirmation commits neither visit nor newly created ERP.
budgets.testPlan: Focused compatibility, sync, UI, analytics, export and Graph tests; exact-head GitHub verify, disposable PostgreSQL, E2E and Vercel certification; Owner-only read-only production gate package.

acceptance.description: Migration 048 establishes canonical Field Visit ERP observation, atomic ERP resolution, None vs Not captured, zero backfill, and no cross-authority mutation.
Retailer and Distributor ERP input closes local/offline/sync/server/read with existing ERP, custom ERP, and explicit None.
Admin ERP Intelligence and export provide separate Retailer/Distributor latest-unique-business analytics.
Compatibility, security, and Graph knowledge remain correct.
Focused compatibility and feature tests plus exact-head GitHub and Vercel certification pass under Graph v1.3.
Owner manually applies Migration 048 and read-only production certification confirms the expected schema and safety invariants.
